prompt: Cho <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>y</mi></mrow></semantics></math> là hai số thực dương và <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></semantics></math> là hai số thực tùy ý. Đẳng thức nào sau đây là sai?

choices.text: <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>m</mi></msup><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi><mi>n</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></semantics></math>

solution: Đẳng thức <math display="inline" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>m</mi></msup><msup><mi>y</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mo stretchy="true" form="prefix">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>y</mi><mo stretchy="true" form="postfix">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>m</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>n</mi></mrow></msup></mrow></semantics></math> sai.
